# ECN-2026-002 - Change notice - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HT03

Reason for change
- Background: During a recent review of heat treat process capability and post-process metallurgical data for parts processed on EQ-P1-L4-HT03, process engineering and quality identified a variance between intended austenitizing energy input and the furnace control setpoint history. The variance correlated with marginal case depth consistency on a segment of production parts subjected to the existing control strategy. The change is intended to tighten metallurgical consistency and bring process documentation and control setpoints into alignment with current metallurgical requirements.
- Rationale: Consolidating the documented austenitizing setpoint with the furnace control configuration reduces ambiguity for operators and maintenance staff, and reduces risk of downstream nonconformance. The specific actionable change is the formal specification of the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P1-L4-HT03 as the single authoritative value used in process control, machine setup, and shop floor documentation.

Affected items
- Equipment affected: EQ-P1-L4-HT03 (Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3) is the only equipment affected by this notice.
- Procedures and work instructions: SOP-P1-L4-03 will be updated to reflect the new authoritative austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P1-L4-HT03 and to include verification steps for setpoint confirmation during startup and before each production run.
- Maintenance documents: MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 will be revised to include check procedures that confirm controller parameters for EQ-P1-L4-HT03 match the authoritative setpoint and to record the results of setpoint confirmation after maintenance actions that impact the control loop.
- Quality processes: QS-PROC-05 will be annotated to indicate that quality verification for heat treat acceptance includes confirmation of the austenitizing setpoint recorded in furnace controller logs and operator pre-run checklists.
- Inventory items and product families processed on EQ-P1-L4-HT03 are indirectly affected; operators will be required to follow the updated SOP-P1-L4-03 checklist for any job scheduled on EQ-P1-L4-HT03.

Implementation
- Authoritative setpoint: The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 880 °C. This value is the single authority for controller configuration, process documentation, and acceptance criteria for parts processed on EQ-P1-L4-HT03.
- Controller update and verification: Process engineering will update the furnace control configuration to reflect the authoritative setpoint. After update, a verification sequence will be executed to confirm that the controller displays and logs the setpoint accurately and that operator pre-run checklists capture the displayed value.
- Procedure updates: SOP-P1-L4-03 will be revised to include explicit steps for setting and verifying the austenitizing setpoint on EQ-P1-L4-HT03, instructions for documenting the displayed setpoint in the operator log, and actions to take if the displayed setpoint does not match the authoritative setpoint.
- Maintenance checks: MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 will be revised to require technicians to confirm controller parameter integrity following any maintenance that affects thermal control elements, with a mandatory entry into the maintenance record that states the controller setpoint matches the authoritative setpoint.
- Quality actions: QS-PROC-05 will be updated to include a requirement that quality inspection records for heat-treated parts include the furnace controller log printout or digital export demonstrating the applied austenitizing setpoint for the batch, and that any deviation triggers the existing nonconformance workflow referenced in QS-PROC-05.
- Training and communication: A short training brief will be issued to affected operators, maintenance technicians, and quality inspectors that explains the change, the location of the authoritative setpoint in process documentation, and the verification steps to be performed. Training attendance and acknowledgment will be recorded in the training management system and referenced in the ECN closure package.
- Examples and expected records: Example artifacts to be created and retained include the revised SOP-P1-L4-03 page with the setpoint confirmation checklist filled out, the MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 maintenance entry confirming controller parameter integrity, and the QS-PROC-05 inspection record containing the furnace controller log or digital export showing the 880 °C setpoint. All artifacts will be retained in the document control system under the existing record retention location for heat treat process documentation.
- Change control and verification: After implementation, a process audit will be performed to verify adherence to the revised SOP-P1-L4-03 and to confirm that operating logs for a representative set of runs on EQ-P1-L4-HT03 reflect the authoritative setpoint. Any nonconformances discovered during the audit will be handled through the corrective action process defined in QS-PROC-05.

Approvals
- Responsible engineering approver: Process engineering signoff is required to finalize the control configuration change for EQ-P1-L4-HT03 and to approve the revised SOP-P1-L4-03 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 content prior to release.
- Quality approver: Quality management must approve the updates to QS-PROC-05 and the acceptance criteria that reference the 880 °C setpoint as part of heat treat verification.
- Maintenance approver: Maintenance management must approve the MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3 revisions and confirm training requirements for technicians.
- Closure requirements: For ECN closure, submit the following package referencing this ECN: revised SOP-P1-L4-03, revised MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3, revised QS-PROC-05 annotations, controller configuration export for EQ-P1-L4-HT03 showing the authoritative setpoint, representative operator pre-run checklists, maintenance entries showing post-maintenance verification, and training attendance records. The change will be closed when all approvers have signed and the closure package is accepted for retention by document control.

Related documents: MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3, QS-PROC-05, SOP-P1-L4-03
